attBesluta.text: The stainless construction gives this steamer a sturdy feel and makes sense for an appliance that gets regular use around moisture and steam. I have found the two-tier setup especially useful when preparing several portions at once. The 1500W power helps it heat efficiently, and the controls are simple enough that I do not need to keep checking the manual. The display is easy to read and the knob gives quick adjustment. Cleanup is also straightforward because most of the exterior can be wiped down quickly.

This roller is solid enough, and it works as advertised. Easy to roll 1/8" mild steel bar. Two minor issues. The flat bar being rolled tends to move off the center of the rollers as the bar is being run through, requiring frequent repositioning. Also, the paint isn't powder coated and flakes off far too easily -- of course doesn't affect useability, but either better pre-paint surface prep or a higher quality paint or both would be appropriate.

Apparaat was goed verpakt en onbeschadigd aangekomen. Voelt solide aan. Wat mij tegen viel was dat de gemaakte schroefdraad erg taps is. Je hoopt op een cilinder vorm. Wanneer je een fitting hierop wilt schroeven sla je meteen 2 slagen over. Dit vanwege de geringe diameter. Ondanks de teflon tape had ik een lekkage na het afdoppen. Tip: draai draad tot net voorbij de laatste tand en zaag daarna de 2 laatste stukje schroefdraad af. En minstens 6 slagen teflon tape gebruiken. En vergeet de snijolie niet!
Works well for my home built camper, good stabilisation and relatively simple to use. I can adjust to exactly the right level.

Já montei os estabilizadores da Vevor no meu reboque. A qualidade parece-me boa e os materiais dão uma sensação de robustez. No entanto, notei que não ficam totalmente firmes e acabam por abanar um pouco quando estão em uso. Talvez, colocando uns calços de madeira por baixo, consigam estabilizar melhor e reduzir esse movimento. No geral, considero que têm uma boa relação qualidade/preço, mas podiam ser um pouco mais estáveis.
Super für meinen Anhänger, leider etwas flugrost nach wenigen Wochen, aber wegen des top Preis leistungsverhältniss trotzdem top
